```{r}
library(nlme)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```

# 1. load data
```{r}
# Read all lines and find where data starts
all_lines <- readLines("vv.txt")

# Find the line that starts the numeric data
data_start <- which(grepl("^[[:space:]]*[0-9]+[[:space:]]+[0-9]", all_lines))[1]
cat("Data starts at line:", data_start, "\n")

# Read the data starting from the first data line
vv <- read.table("vv.txt", skip = data_start - 1, header = FALSE)
colnames(vv) <- c("id", "smoking", "time", "FEV1")

# look at the data
head(vv, 20)
str(vv)
summary(vv)
dim(vv)

#just for sanity
cat("Number of subjects:", length(unique(vv$id)), "\n")
cat("Total observations:", nrow(vv), "\n")
```


```{r}
# make variables numeric and factor for easier analysis and group assignment
vv$time_numeric <- as.numeric(vv$time)
vv$smoking_label <- factor(vv$smoking,
                           levels = c(0, 1),
                           labels = c("Former Smoker", "Current Smoker"))

# Sort by subject and time
vv <- vv[order(vv$id, vv$time_numeric), ]

# Create grouped data object for nlme, 
vv_grouped <- groupedData(FEV1 ~ time_numeric | id, data = vv)
head(vv_grouped)
```

# 2. make a trajectory plot
```{r}
#group by time and smoking status, and get mean, sd, sum, and se for FEV1
trajectory_data <- vv %>%
  group_by(time_numeric, smoking_label) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_fev1 = mean(FEV1, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_fev1 = sd(FEV1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_obs = sum(!is.na(FEV1)),
    se_fev1 = sd_fev1 / sqrt(n_obs),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(time_numeric) # in order
head(trajectory_data)

# Plot
plot_trajectory <- ggplot(trajectory_data,
                          aes(x = time_numeric,
                              y = mean_fev1,
                              color = smoking_label,     # easy to visualize
                              shape = smoking_label,
                              group = smoking_label)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2, alpha = 0.8) +                   # just aesthetics
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_fev1 - se_fev1,
                    ymax = mean_fev1 + se_fev1),
                width = 0.3, size = 0.8, alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean FEV1 Over Time by Smoking Status",
    x = "Time from Baseline (Years)",
    y = "Mean FEV1 (L)",
    color = "Smoking Status"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(plot_trajectory)
```

# 3. fit three models

## Linear
```{r}
model_linear <- gls(FEV1 ~ time_numeric * smoking,
                    data = vv_grouped,
                    correlation = corCompSymm(form = ~ 1 | id),
                    na.action = na.omit,
                    method = "REML") # might need changing?
print(summary(model_linear))


ll_linear <- as.numeric(logLik(model_linear)) #log likelihood
np_linear <- attr(logLik(model_linear), "df") #finding the number of parametrs

#-155.8016 and 6, respectively
```

## Saturated
```{r}
model_saturated <- gls(FEV1 ~ factor(time_numeric) * smoking, #time is a factor
                       data = vv_grouped,
                       correlation = corCompSymm(form = ~ 1 | id),
                       na.action = na.omit,
                       method = "REML")
print(summary(model_saturated))


ll_saturated <- as.numeric(logLik(model_saturated))
np_saturated <- attr(logLik(model_saturated), "df")

#-164.0459 and 16, respectively
```

## Quadratic
```{r}
model_quadratic <- gls(FEV1 ~ (time_numeric + I(time_numeric^2)) * smoking,
                       data = vv_grouped,
                       correlation = corCompSymm(form = ~ 1 | id),
                       na.action = na.omit,
                       method = "REML")
print(summary(model_quadratic))

ll_quadratic <- as.numeric(logLik(model_quadratic))
np_quadratic <- attr(logLik(model_quadratic), "df")

#-169.4238 and 8, respectively
```

All of the models are compared to each other and have the outputs of that
comparison formatted in the same way for eventual knitting to .pdf

```{r}
# LIKELIHOOD RATIO TESTS and ALPHA = 0.01

# Linear vs Saturated
lrt_1 <- -2 * (ll_linear - ll_saturated)
df_1 <- np_saturated - np_linear
p_1 <- 1 - pchisq(lrt_1, df = df_1)

#this is just for printing out the results of lrt, df, and p for this test
cat("LRT Statistic:", round(lrt_1, 4), "\n")
cat("DF:", df_1, "\n")
cat("P-value:", round(p_1, 6), "\n")

#if else loops because why not
if (p_1 < 0.01) {
  cat("Decision: Linear INADEQUATE\n")
  test1_adequate <- FALSE
} else {
  cat("Decision: Linear ADEQUATE\n")
  test1_adequate <- TRUE
}
```



```{r}
# Quadratic vs Saturated
cat("\n\nTEST 2: QUADRATIC vs SATURATED\n")
lrt_2 <- -2 * (ll_quadratic - ll_saturated)
df_2 <- np_saturated - np_quadratic
p_2 <- 1 - pchisq(lrt_2, df = df_2)

cat("LRT Statistic:", round(lrt_2, 4), "\n")
cat("DF:", df_2, "\n")
cat("P-value:", round(p_2, 6), "\n")

if (p_2 < 0.01) {
  cat("Decision: Quadratic INADEQUATE\n")
  test2_adequate <- FALSE
} else {
  cat("Decision: Quadratic ADEQUATE\n")
  test2_adequate <- TRUE
}
```



```{r}
# TEST 3: Linear vs Quadratic
cat("\n\nTEST 3: LINEAR vs QUADRATIC\n")
lrt_3 <- -2 * (ll_linear - ll_quadratic)
df_3 <- np_quadratic - np_linear
p_3 <- 1 - pchisq(lrt_3, df = df_3)

cat("LRT Statistic:", round(lrt_3, 4), "\n")
cat("DF:", df_3, "\n")
cat("P-value:", round(p_3, 6), "\n")

if (p_3 < 0.01) {
  cat("Decision: Linear INADEQUATE vs Quadratic\n")
} else {
  cat("Decision: Linear ADEQUATE vs Quadratic\n")
}
```

```{r}
#model selection based on adequacy in previous chunk

if (test1_adequate) {
  selected_model <- model_linear
  model_name <- "LINEAR"
  cat("Selected: LINEAR MODEL\n")
} else if (test2_adequate) {
  selected_model <- model_quadratic
  model_name <- "QUADRATIC"
  cat("Selected: QUADRATIC MODEL\n")
} else {
  selected_model <- model_saturated
  model_name <- "SATURATED"
  cat("Selected: SATURATED MODEL\n")
}

cat("Model for predictions:", model_name, "\n\n")
```

The linear is the chosen model here!

# 4. FEV1 change predictions
```{r}
# create prediction dataset
pred_data <- expand.grid(
  time_numeric = c(3, 6, 9, 15),
  smoking = c(0, 1)
)
pred_data$smoking_label <- factor(pred_data$smoking,
                                  levels = c(0, 1),
                                  labels = c("Former Smoker", "Current Smoker"))

# Get predictions
pred_data$predicted_fev1 <- predict(selected_model,
                                     newdata = pred_data,
                                     level = 0)
head(pred_data)
```

Dividng up by year 3 to 6, 9 to 15, never smokers, and between groups

```{r}
# year 3 to 6

fev1_3_current <- pred_data$predicted_fev1[pred_data$time_numeric == 3 & pred_data$smoking == 1]
fev1_6_current <- pred_data$predicted_fev1[pred_data$time_numeric == 6 &  pred_data$smoking == 1]
change_3_6_current <- fev1_6_current - fev1_3_current

fev1_3_former <- pred_data$predicted_fev1[pred_data$time_numeric == 3 & pred_data$smoking == 0]
fev1_6_former <- pred_data$predicted_fev1[pred_data$time_numeric == 6 & pred_data$smoking == 0]
change_3_6_former <- fev1_6_former - fev1_3_former

cat("Year 3 to 6, Always-Smokers:  Change =", round(change_3_6_current, 4), "L\n")
cat("Year 3 to 6, Never-Smokers:   Change =", round(change_3_6_former, 4), "L\n")
```

```{r}
# year 9 to 15
fev1_9_current <- pred_data$predicted_fev1[pred_data$time_numeric == 9 & pred_data$smoking == 1]
fev1_15_current <- pred_data$predicted_fev1[pred_data$time_numeric == 15 & pred_data$smoking == 1]
change_9_15_current <- fev1_15_current - fev1_9_current

fev1_9_former <- pred_data$predicted_fev1[pred_data$time_numeric == 9 & pred_data$smoking == 0]
fev1_15_former <- pred_data$predicted_fev1[pred_data$time_numeric == 15 & pred_data$smoking == 0]
change_9_15_former <- fev1_15_former - fev1_9_former

cat("Year 9 to 15, Always-Smokers:  Change =", round(change_9_15_current, 4), "L\n")
cat("Year 9 to 15, Never-Smokers:   Change =", round(change_9_15_former, 4), "L\n")
```
